acceptance.canonicalization_algorithm: JCS_LIKE_V1: recursively normalize JSON object keys and string values to Unicode NFC; reject normalized-key collisions before serialization; UTF-8; objects sorted lexicographically by normalized key; arrays preserve order; version fields require JSON integer type exactly; separators comma/colon; no insignificant whitespace; LF only
acceptance.duplicate_gate: Derive the versioned domain-tagged canonical-JSON semantic-core idempotency key before any write. A candidate with an already-observed identical key is classified DUPLICATE and produces no event, no CURRENT update, and no Slack post. Best-effort repository search must show no existing proposed key before the first write.
acceptance.idempotency_formula: sha256(canonical_json_utf8({domain:'hfo.gen133.x12.idempotency.semantic-core.v3',semantic_core:{campaign_id,controlled_probe_name,current_blob,expected_version,next_version,object_id,prior_digest_sha256,task_id,transition_kind,wake_ordinal}})); nonce, valid_time, transaction_time, runtime/tool metadata, verifier runtime metadata, and Slack metadata are excluded
acceptance.next_wake_requirement: If accepted, run X12_STALE_CONCURRENT_WRITER_SIMULATION_C10 wake 1/4 from CURRENT v36. Vary only the stale/concurrent-writer probe, reject duplicate idempotency keys and stale expected versions, and do not claim database or cross-system transaction guarantees.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Event-first. After immutable event commit and exact readback, fetch CURRENT a second time and require exact version 35, projection digest b6ae21b21d5808115bcdbb5885f80d4234e0a950e76ebe9d9fe583b8a12154bc, and blob 0ce1a5863d5fe3b91e87d189316afa1f52d57c4c. Replace CURRENT only using that exact blob SHA. Then read back CURRENT, the v36 event, and the v35 predecessor event and require exact latest-event, predecessor-event, prior-digest, prior-CURRENT, campaign-decision, next-campaign, and idempotency-measurement bindings.
acceptance.slack_post_rule: Post one sanitized pointer only after CURRENT advances to v36. A duplicate or unchanged transition produces no Slack post.
acceptance.stale_version_gate: Any expected-version or prior-blob mismatch must fail the single-file CURRENT replacement and must not be retried as an unconditional overwrite.

experiment.baseline: CURRENT v35 at blob 0ce1a5863d5fe3b91e87d189316afa1f52d57c4c; C9 idempotency_strategy 3/4; prior event digest 3e871eb006f4ae7aa6181fe54ca36b1f03bdda764afc121b8c2164d7118efdf3. Wake 1 excluded nonce/time variance, wake 2 replaced ambiguous delimiter joining with canonical JSON, and wake 3 added explicit domain separation.
experiment.controlled_factor: Idempotency-key preimage scope only. Compare hashing an entire execution envelope against hashing the retained versioned domain-tagged semantic allowlist while runtime observation fields, tool ordering, and Slack projection metadata vary. Retain event-first ordering, exact second CURRENT read, compact dual anchors, exact prior blob-SHA replacement, and sequential post-update triangulation.
experiment.exact_probe: Construct candidate envelope A and candidate envelope B for the same v35-to-v36 semantic transition. Vary only runtime observation timestamp, tool-array ordering, Slack projection wording, and one optional connector-observation field. Verify whole-envelope canonical digests differ while the versioned domain-tagged semantic-core keys are identical. Derive the accepted key from the allowlisted X12 wrapper, require zero repository matches for that key, accept at most one transition, close C9 with KEEP, and select stale/concurrent writer simulation as C10.
experiment.honest_flaw: This is a bounded local Python/JCS-like specimen, not RFC 8785 or cross-language proof. The allowlist can incorrectly collapse distinct operations if a semantically material field is omitted, and schema evolution can create incompatible key spaces unless domain/version changes are governed. GitHub code search is best-effort, non-atomic, can lag, and is not a uniqueness constraint. The immutable event and CURRENT are separate commits and Slack follows both, so a crash can leave an orphan event or missing Slack pointer. GitHub's per-file blob-SHA guard does not provide cross-file atomicity, locks, linearizability, serializable isolation, database durability, exactly-once execution, referential integrity, server-side uniqueness, or automatic repair.
experiment.hypothesis: A versioned domain-tagged semantic allowlist preserves one idempotency key across benign runtime-envelope variance, whereas hashing the whole execution envelope creates false negatives for duplicate detection.
experiment.rollback: Never delete the immutable event or Slack message. If the retained idempotency strategy is later rejected, append a compensating event from the then-current version and replace CURRENT only using that pointer file's exact then-current blob SHA; preserve all C9 specimens and reconstruct history from immutable events and referenced prior CURRENT blobs.

experiment.strongest_falsifier: Whole-envelope variants produce the same digest despite different metadata; the semantic allowlist variants produce different keys; a semantically material field omitted from the allowlist permits a false duplicate; the proposed key already existed but search missed it; the same key advances state twice; an expected-version or prior-blob mismatch still advances CURRENT; event bytes fail digest recomputation; or final CURRENT/event/predecessor bindings disagree.
